label: digit 1 late in the original phase of sequences starting with m
explanation: Sparse feature (0.018% of steps) that fires only in the original phase at t=4..8 (peak t=5-6) and on the delimiter; it never fires in the copy phase or at t<4. Its activation mass comes from two factors that combine: the input is the digit 1 (66% of mass, 18x lift), and the sequence starts with m (73% of mass, 20x lift). The strongest activations (0.7-1.0 of max) are all on a 1 at step 4-6 in a sequence starting with m, often with g/e/digits early on (e.g. m g 3 e c w [1]). Weaker activations land on other tokens late in m-initial sequences, or on a 1 in sequences that do not start with m. Many m-initial sequences with a late 1 do not activate, so precision is low (about 0.23). The conjunction captures only about 41% of the mass, so this is an incomplete description of a conjunctive feature.
